correctness.notes: oracle passed on every measured cell | 170 cells dropped for lack of a control value (a cell-list batch run under the other requirement carries the same cells without the reference's path, their twins with a control are in the card), for example N1024 k4 bf16 prefer_smaller_index latency | phase 3 final evaluation, harness 0.10, 0.11, nodes umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094 | cells come from more than one node, see the node field of every cell: umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094

low_level: Registers 62 to 255 over the 693 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (233 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 7952 to 169584 bytes, harness 0.10, 0.11 on umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094.
Adapter statics: input arrangement striped, output indices, temp storage 7920 to 136816 bytes.
Oracle battery (23 cases per cell plus the measurement seeds) passed on every cell that has a number, no cell unsupported, no cell failed the oracle.
algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on umbriel-b200-047): latency not_guaranteed wins 32 of 77 cells (runner-up in 6), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 32 of 75 cells (runner-up in 7), throughput not_guaranteed wins 24 of 84 cells (runner-up in 7), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 27 of 74 cells (runner-up in 8).

Where it wins on random input (bf16 N 8192, bf16 N 16384, bf16 N 32768, fp32 N 8192, fp32 N 16384, fp32 N 32768), the median margin over the runner-up is +51 percent and over the scope's reference control +148 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): bf16 N 1024 k 4 +694 percent behind B2_packed@T128 in throughput prefer_smaller_index, bf16 N 4096 k 4 +498 percent behind B2_twolevel in latency prefer_smaller_index, bf16 N 16384 k 4 +484 percent behind B2_twolevel in latency prefer_smaller_index, bf16 N 1024 k 8 +452 percent behind B2_packed@T128 in throughput prefer_smaller_index.

Tie-heavy input (unshuffled, umbriel-b200-068): latency not_guaranteed wins 0 of 55 cells (runner-up in 0), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 0 of 37 cells (runner-up in 0), throughput not_guaranteed wins 0 of 55 cells (runner-up in 0), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 0 of 37 cells (runner-up in 0).

Shuffled tie-heavy input (harness 0.11, umbriel-b200-094): latency not_guaranteed wins 17 of 35 cells (15 as B4_v4, 2 as B4_v4@T512, runner-up in 4), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 18 of 35 cells (15 as B4_v4, 3 as B4_v4@T512, runner-up in 2), throughput not_guaranteed wins 13 of 35 cells (11 as B4_v4, 1 as B4_v4@T512, 1 as B4_v4@T128, runner-up in 0), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 9 of 35 cells (8 as B4_v4, 1 as B4_v4@T128, runner-up in 8).

Named workloads won on random input: beam_search_chunk, dsa_v4_flash_chunk_32k_k512, dsa_v4_pro_chunk_32k_k1024, eagle_vocab_topk_sglang, quest_pages_128k_budget4096, sampling_chunk_32k_k64, snapkv_32k_budget1024.
negative: On the unshuffled tie_heavy pattern (period 64 divides the 256-thread stripe, every striped thread holds 64 copies of one value) the minimum of the thread maxima equals the tile minimum, every item is a candidate and the tile fallback runs: fp32 N 16384 k 32 reads 19153 cycles against 4626 on random input, behind B3_tuned. The shuffled tie pattern (harness 0.11) removes the alignment and returns B4_v4 to its fast path (5316, ahead of B3_tuned at 18582).
surprises: The phase 3 region N 8192 to 32768 runs at 254 to 255 registers, one block per SM, so the win is a latency win at low occupancy. verify-B4 confirmed the phase 3 card cells on umbriel-b200-068 under harness 0.10 (48 cells, ratios 0.965 to 1.043, no flips), the wave 2 cards had been confirmed under harness 0.8, and the k 4096 cells stay behind B3_tuned.
open_questions: A cheaper fallback detection for tie floods (count the bound's ties before running the full tile path) and whether k = N/4 can be rescued by a second bound.

GB200 pass on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99 (WINNERS_gb200.md): the warp and sub-warp winners agree on 359 of 376 common cells (365 of 376 when each cell is compared through the adapters both passes measured, as section 16 of the knowledge base does), the differences are named sub-warp lane-count cells, N 128 sub-warp throughput cells and warp ties within 5 percent, and in the block matrices the B1_idx against B1_det2 throughput ties fall either way. The GB200 k 64 cells at 128 threads run 3 to 15 percent slower than on B200 (hw-researcher, a generation property).
